description: Initial run: default weights W_INHIBITION=1.0 W_UNCERTAINTY=1.0, 3-member FFN ensemble, 10% initial labeled data (65 pos), 1000 selected, 74 true hits (7.4%), novelty=0.42, diversity=0.85

DNI strategy: W_INHIBITION=1.0 W_UNCERTAINTY=1.0 W_NOVELTY=2.0 W_DIVERSITY=0.5, epochs=75, greedy diverse batch selection (top-5k pool). High novelty (0.68) and diversity (0.91) but only 10/1000 hits. AUROC flat vs baseline (~0.596). ~15K in / ~8K out tokens, est. cost ~$0.003. Cumulative: $0.003.

pos_weight fix (POS_WEIGHT=10), custom training loop with weighted BCE. Rebalanced acquisition: W_INHIBITION=5 W_UNCERTAINTY=0 W_NOVELTY=0.5 W_DIVERSITY=0.2. Dropout=0.3, hidden_dim=256, epochs=15, oversample 20% positives. 95/1000 hits (9.5% vs 1.0% in iter1). AUROC flat at 0.597. Est. ~12K in / ~6K out tokens, ~$0.003. Cumulative: ~$0.006.

Increased model capacity (hidden_dim=512), weight_decay=1e-4, epochs=20, oversample 30%. AUROC dropped to 0.589 - POS_WEIGHT=10 caused training instability (val loss 0.47 vs 0.05 in iter2). Found 65/1000 hits. Est. ~12K in / ~6K out tokens, ~$0.003. Cumulative: ~$0.009.

Reduced POS_WEIGHT=3, dropout=0.4, epochs=15, oversample 20%. Training stabilized (val loss 0.19-0.31). AUROC=0.599 (best), AUPRC=0.030 (best). Hit discovery dropped to 47/1000 — easy hits exhausted. Est. ~12K in / ~6K out tokens, ~$0.003. Cumulative: ~$0.012.

Increased exploration (W_NOVELTY=1.0, W_DIVERSITY=0.3). AUROC jumped to 0.612 (best, +0.013), AUPRC=0.034 (best). Novelty 0.485, diversity 0.874. Only 30/1000 hits — remaining pool positives harder to find. Est. ~12K in / ~6K out tokens, ~$0.003. Cumulative: ~$0.015.

Pushed exploration (W_NOVELTY=2.0, W_DIVERSITY=0.5). AUROC=0.614 (+0.002), AUPRC=0.037 (best). Novelty 0.565, diversity 0.888 — exploring diverse chemical space. 24/1000 hits. Est. ~12K in / ~6K out tokens, ~$0.003. Cumulative: ~$0.018.

Continued exploration (W_NOVELTY=2, W_DIVERSITY=0.5). AUROC jumped to 0.641 (+0.027)! AUPRC=0.039 (best). Diverse positives accumulated (344 total) finally improving generalization. 14/1000 hits. Est. ~12K in / ~6K out tokens, ~$0.003. Cumulative: ~$0.021.

Continued exploration strategy. AUROC=0.637 (slight dip from 0.641, still strong). AUPRC=0.037. 14/1000 hits. Pool positives getting exhausted. Est. ~12K in / ~6K out tokens, ~$0.003. Cumulative: ~$0.024.

Balanced DNI strategy (W_INH=3, W_NOV=2, W_DIV=0.5). Precomputed sim matrix optimized greedy selection. AUROC recovered to 0.641 (best), AUPRC=0.039 (best). 8/1000 hits, novelty=0.55, diversity=0.89. Est. ~15K in / ~8K out tokens, ~$0.003. Cumulative: ~$0.030.

Exploration-dominated (W_INH=1.0, W_NOV=2.5, W_DIV=0.5). NEW BEST AUROC=0.645 (+0.004), AUPRC=0.040. 10/1000 hits. Novelty 0.567 exploring new chemical space. Est. ~15K in / ~8K out tokens, ~$0.003. Cumulative: ~$0.036.

Pure exploration (W_INH=0.5, W_NOV=2.5, W_DIV=0.5). HUGE AUROC jump to 0.664 (+0.019)! AUPRC=0.042 (best). Low inhibition lets diversity/novelty dominate. 5/1000 hits. Est. ~15K in / ~8K out tokens, ~$0.003. Cumulative: ~$0.042.

Continued pure exploration. AUROC dipped to 0.655 (-0.009) but AUPRC still improving (0.042, new best). Pool positives getting exhausted. 5/1000 hits. Est. ~15K in / ~8K out tokens, ~$0.003. Cumulative: ~$0.048.

Rebalanced (W_INH=1.5, W_NOV=2.0, W_DIV=0.5). AUROC recovered to 0.662 (close to best 0.664). 23 hits found - best hit discovery in 5 iterations. Model stabilizing. Est. ~15K in / ~8K out tokens, ~$0.003. Cumulative: ~$0.054.

Continued rebalanced strategy. NEW BEST AUROC=0.667 (+0.006) exceeding other branch's 0.666! AUPRC=0.042 (best). 13/1000 hits. Model generalizing well with diverse training data. Est. ~15K in / ~8K out tokens, ~$0.003. Cumulative: ~$0.060.

Continued winning strategy. HUGE AUROC jump to 0.678 (+0.011)! AUPRC=0.044 (best). Model still improving strongly with more diverse training data (24,764 compounds). 8/1000 hits. Est. ~15K in / ~8K out tokens, ~$0.003. Cumulative: ~$0.066.

Continued same strategy. AUROC 0.672 (slight pullback from 0.678 but still above 0.667 best). AUPRC=0.042. 12 hits found. Model oscillating around 0.67. Est. ~15K in / ~8K out tokens, ~$0.003. Cumulative: ~$0.072.
Same config. AUROC 0.666, AUPRC=0.045 (new best). Model plateauing at 0.67. 11 hits. Pool positives depleting (377 left). Est. ~15K in / ~8K out tokens, ~$0.003. Cumulative: ~$0.078.
